title: Bridging Ethical Principles and Algorithmic Methods: An Alternative Approach for Assessing Trustworthiness in AI Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI Ethics and Trustworthy AI. It presents a meta-analysis of AI ethics guidelines and proposes a quantitative assessment framework to bridge ethical principles (like fairness, accountability, and transparency) with algorithmic methods (PageRank and TrustRank), directly engaging in the evaluation of ethical requirements in AI systems.
